verdict: You are physically on the Eastside Beltline, and you press-released exactly that, yet every "Beltline" search hands the customer to shops named after the trail. The fastest fix: claim the Beltline in your homepage title, your schema, and the 2026 Atlanta e-bike lists, and you win the ground you already stand on.
